**Apply `reasoningEffortMapping` to native Anthropic effort.** For `between_tools`, inbound conversion stores `output_config.effort` only in metadata and sets `ReasoningEffort` to `none`. The route mapper therefore cannot match `xhigh`, and Anthropic outbound restores the unmapped `xhigh` value. This bypasses the configured `xhigh` → `high` mapping. Keep `ReasoningEffort` as `none` for other protocols, but use the metadata effort as the mapping source for `between_tools` and update only that metadata.
🐛 Suggested fix
```diff - mapped := llm.ApplyReasoningEffortMapping(req.ReasoningEffort, channelSettings.TransformOptions.ReasoningEffortMapping) - if mapped == req.ReasoningEffort { + mappingEffort := req.ReasoningEffort + preserveNone := false + if req.ReasoningEffort == llm.ReasoningEffortNone && req.TransformerMetadata != nil { + thinkingType, _ := req.TransformerMetadata[anthropic.TransformerMetadataKeyThinkingType].(string) + if nativeEffort, ok := req.TransformerMetadata[anthropic.TransformerMetadataKeyOutputConfigEffort].(string); ok && + thinkingType == "between_tools" && nativeEffort != "" { + mappingEffort = nativeEffort + preserveNone = true + } + } + + mapped := llm.ApplyReasoningEffortMapping(mappingEffort, channelSettings.TransformOptions.ReasoningEffortMapping) + if mapped == mappingEffort { return req } @@ - newReq.ReasoningEffort = mapped + if !preserveNone { + newReq.ReasoningEffort = mapped + } ```

Keep the existing `ReasoningEffort` assignment behavior for other thinking types and protocols. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
✅ Confirmed as addressed by @pcbeingused333

Good catch, fixed in c25574b0: with `between_tools`, `applyReasoningEffortMapping` now maps the native `output_config.effort` stored in `TransformerMetadata` (the unified `ReasoningEffort` stays `none`, so other protocols still see thinking off). This matters here because, on Sonnet 5.5, `between_tools` is only accepted at effort `high` or below, so a mapping such as `max` → `high` is what makes such a request valid. Added a case to `TestApplyReasoningEffortMapping`; it fails without the change, and `go test ./internal/server/orchestrator` passes.
